name: Saeki Yuugo
source:
Head of the Mikado Medical Research Instititute. He is also [url=/c20516]Mikado Kagura[/url]'s tutor, as well as [url=/c48624]Sara[/url]'s husband.

[spoiler]He is also [url=/c20476]Saeki Asuna[/url]'s younger fraternal twin brother. [url=/c48624]Sara[/url] offered to help him by using the Necronomicon to revive his dead sister, and regularly refers to him as "Master".[/spoiler]
